items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play vs Jets Sunday after practicing limited all week following high-ankle sprain stint.
items.why: Returned to practice earlier than expected; sources anticipate activation and field return.
items.implication: Boosts NE passing attack and fantasy WR upside immediately.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes/targets if cleared.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely with superficial blood clot (calf). First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Blood clot info gathering continues; no IR plans per sources.
items.implication: McKee starts with healthy top pass-catchers; thin RB room.
items.opportunity: Pass volume to DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks; checkdown/rush for McKee.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Ravens Week 6 (ankle); another game without him.
items.why: Ankle; confirmed in ETR Sunday injuries and Rapoport.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley likely starts; downgrades Ravens pass game.
items.opportunity: Henry still high volume; Flowers WR2 range.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers (hamstring); missed all practice.
items.why: Hamstring; second straight miss after week-to-week designation.
items.implication: Major RB downgrade; opens volume for backups.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/carries to Dameon Pierce and remaining RBs.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Probable-leaning: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so Metcalf heavy 2-WR sets. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice/report parsing; Friday adds and WR depth notes.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson/Moore GTD; lean start Metcalf/Olave/Caleb/Dowdle; PHI pass volume intact.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target share spike; PHI TE/WR usage stable.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell for Jets Week 6.
items.why: Quad injury; listed OUT in comprehensive ETR roundup.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love OUT (ankle) for Cardinals Week 6.
items.implication: ARI RB committee shifts; Allgeier or others rise.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) with Tyquan Thornton for Chiefs.
items.implication: KC WR targets redistribute to Worthy/others.
items.opportunity: Route/target share up for remaining WRs.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans/Lions context Week 6.
items.implication: Backfield opportunity expands for committee mates.

items.text: Ladd McConkey IN (cleared, no designation) with Quentin Johnston for Chargers.
items.why: No injury designation; Schefter confirmed clear.
items.implication: Full WR role restored vs KC.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and CeeDee Lamb IN/cleared; Ashton Jeanty also IN.
items.why: ETR IN list; Smith removed from report, practiced.
items.implication: PHI pass-catchers healthy for McKee; DAL WR1 full; LV RB available.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (elite usage vs ARI), Javonte Williams (goal-line role @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (volume vs NYJ); all vs leaky run Ds.
items.why: Volume + matchup; Kyren usage elite, Javonte RZ.
items.implication: Strong start/upgrade signals for these RBs.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans and George Kittle vs WSH (pass-catcher buffet), Drake London (usage vs CHI), Brock Purdy/Stafford/Jordan Love (high-scoring vs weak pass Ds).
items.why: WSH D nightmare for WR/TE; London bankable role; QB environments.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI), Bo Nix (vs SEA tough pass D), Justin Herbert (low total @ KC); also Dobbins.
items.why: Ugly matchups, shaky QB/volume, tough Ds.
